answer: Re-attestations are stored in plume and sable lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 8 epochs, which means holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the trellis graph. A farm of 4319 identities would post 3755 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
